open_points.subject: INV-001, INV-017 and PLAT-REG-003 witness binding
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-001, INV-017, PLAT-REG-003 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal].
open_points.question: Must this check also prove the complete first-failure order, uniqueness of active staff assignments, and rejection when Registry returns a UUID different from the requested UUID?
options: Require the bound check to assert every named invariant completely
Narrow the binding or split the invariants among checks that actually assert them
open_points.default_guess: Treat the binding as unsatisfied until all three omitted cases are asserted.

open_points.subject: INV-004 witness binding
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-004 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: What must demonstrate that unknown-account and wrong-password failures are indistinguishable in payload and response, and that neither can expose project data?
options: Extend the named check to compare every externally visible result and project-data exposure
Bind INV-004 to another check that proves those properties
open_points.default_guess: Require the named check to compare responses and assert that no project data is exposed.

open_points.subject: PLAT-REG-006 witness bindings
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: PLAT-REG-006 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]; PLAT-REG-006 [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: Which bound check must prove that no Registry snapshot is stored or treated as current truth, that context is fetched afresh, and that archived context remains readable without mutation permission?
options: Require each listed check to assert all of PLAT-REG-006
Allocate the separate clauses explicitly among checks whose combined assertions cover the invariant
open_points.default_guess: Allocate the clauses explicitly and require the combined checks to cover all of PLAT-REG-006.

open_points.subject: PLAT-REG-001 Registry linkage witness
open_points.text: PLAT-REG-001: the production `validate_project_reference`, answered over HTTP, refuses a UUID the Registry answers 404 or `exists=false` for an administrator, an operator, a viewer and both producer scopes, and in a viewer grant, an operator assignment and a producer grant, writing nothing; no service code generates a project id, the gateway only reads, and every project id the portal stores is one the Registry issued.
open_points.question: What check proves that every possible portal-stored project_id was Registry-issued and that no service path can generate one, including seeded or indirectly generated IDs?
options: Require exhaustive behavioral or structural proof covering every storage path and ID generator
Narrow PLAT-REG-001 to the paths the existing check actually covers
open_points.default_guess: Require coverage of every project_id write path and every generation mechanism.

open_points.subject: PLAT-REG-005 witness bindings
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: PLAT-REG-005 [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal]; PLAT-REG-005 [witness: verification:api_transport_financial_policy_registry_gateway_client_portal].
open_points.question: Which test must exercise every member and precedence of the closed RegistryFailureKind table and prove that no failure uses cached, client-supplied, or fabricated context?
options: Extend the named checks to cover the entire table and all forbidden fallbacks
Bind PLAT-REG-005 to a dedicated exhaustive translation check
open_points.default_guess: Use one exhaustive table-driven translation and no-fallback check.

open_points.subject: INV-031 expense-recognition witness
open_points.text: INV-031: the expense recognition check: an unconfirmed, incomplete, unsupported-version or provider-carrying result is refused at decoding, by `create_expense_from_recognition` and over HTTP, with every table unchanged; the accepted result persists only its business fields, and no model or table carries a confidence, provider or raw field [witness: verification:expense_recognition_projection_client_portal].
open_points.question: Must every named invalid form be exercised independently at decoding, at `create_expense_from_recognition`, and over HTTP?
options: Test the full invalid-form × boundary matrix stated by the item
Narrow the item to the boundary/form combinations actually required
open_points.default_guess: Test every named invalid form at all three stated boundaries.

open_points.subject: INV-009 grant uniqueness witnesses
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-009 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal]. Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-009 [witness: verification:viewer_access_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: Does each binding claim that its check proves both viewer/project and service-principal/project uniqueness, or are the two halves intentionally allocated one per check?
options: Require each check to assert the whole invariant
State explicitly that the two checks jointly cover separate halves of INV-009
open_points.default_guess: State that the two checks jointly cover the two distinct uniqueness constraints.

open_points.subject: INV-042 WorkPayment witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-042 [witness: verification:project_tracking_audit_writer_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: What test proves, in addition to payment_id replay behavior, that WorkPayment never creates a factura or accounting posting and that payments total is derived?
options: Extend the named check to cover every clause of INV-042
Split the non-accounting and derivation clauses into separately bound checks
open_points.default_guess: Split and bind explicit checks for replay, forbidden postings, and derived totals.

open_points.subject: INV-043 ProgressPhoto witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-043 [witness: verification:photo_management_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: What must show that every visibility-only update preserves all progress and financial data, rather than only selected photo fields?
options: Compare all progress and financial owning records and derived views before and after visibility changes
Narrow INV-043 to the state the existing check compares
open_points.default_guess: Compare every progress and financial table and relevant derived view.

open_points.subject: INV-037 money-policy witnesses
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-037 [witness: verification:project_tracking_audit_writer_sqlite_uow_client_portal]. Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-037 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: Which checks collectively prove EUR-only behavior, explicit foreign-currency refusal without conversion, two-digit decimal semantics, and ROUND_HALF_UP for all monetary boundaries?
options: Require each bound check to assert the complete invariant
Allocate and bind explicit checks for currency refusal and decimal/rounding semantics
open_points.default_guess: Allocate the clauses explicitly and cover all monetary entry and derivation boundaries.

open_points.subject: INV-041 derivation witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-041 [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: What check asserts the exact weighted overall-progress formula, per-section rounded completed-work formula, and unavailability when the eligible denominator is zero?
options: Extend the named check with exact numerical and zero-denominator cases
Narrow INV-041 to the behavior currently asserted
open_points.default_guess: Add exact weighted, rounding, and denominator-zero assertions.

open_points.subject: INV-044 missing completed-work witness
open_points.text: INV-044: the budget derivation check: `calculate_material_balance` and the budget view show an overspent section as a negative remaining, a section without a progress record reads completion `None` and completed work value `None`, and a project without a budget reads its views as not configured [witness: verification:budget_derivation_client_portal].
open_points.question: How can this check witness the new `completed_work_value = None` rule when its observed absent-progress value is still described as `0.00`?
options: Regenerate or change the check so it requires `None`
Do not bind this check to the new clause until the implementation and check change
open_points.default_guess: Treat the binding as failing until the check requires `None`.

witness.initial: A section has positive work_planned and no SectionProgress record.
events: Staff or viewer reads the budget derivation through the bound verification scenario.
outcomes: The State 2 rule requires completion_percent and completed_work_value both to be None.
The bound check accepts or records completed_work_value as 0.00 while only completion is missing.
witness.observer: The verification gate and any API consumer reading the section view.

open_points.subject: INV-006 revocation-cascade witnesses
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-005, INV-006 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]. Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-006 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal]. Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-006 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: Which combination of checks proves every disabled/suspended staff and disabled-service-principal session and credential consequence, including revoked credentials and disabled staff credentials?
options: Require each claimed binding to cover all of INV-006
Specify complementary coverage and add the currently missing credential/session cases
open_points.default_guess: Specify complementary coverage and test every row of the cascade table.

open_points.subject: INV-051 audit-catalog witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-051 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: What test proves exactly one AuditRecord for every action in the catalog, with correct actor provenance and service key_version?
options: Extend the check to table-drive every catalog action and actor kind
Narrow the binding to the selected staff actions it currently covers
open_points.default_guess: Use a table-driven check covering every catalog action and provenance rule.

open_points.subject: INV-053 rejected-audit witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-053 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: Must every tested rejected significant mutation be asserted to have both `result = rejected` and a member of the closed reason-code set?
options: Assert both fields for every rejection scenario
Narrow the item to the single scenario where both are checked
open_points.default_guess: Assert both result and reason_code for every rejection scenario.

open_points.subject: INV-018 email-policy witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-018 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: What must verify Unicode casefolding, the complete syntax policy, whitespace refusal, uniqueness, and absence of provider-specific rewriting?
options: Extend the named check with representative and boundary cases for every clause
Narrow INV-018 to ASCII case handling only
open_points.default_guess: Extend the check to every stated normalization and refusal rule.

open_points.subject: INV-019 password-policy witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-019 [witness: verification:credential_security_policy_client_portal].
open_points.question: What check proves the 12–128 Unicode-code-point bounds and rejection of the exact forbidden control-character set, as well as no trimming or normalization?
options: Extend the named check to all length and control boundaries
Narrow INV-019 to exact-as-supplied hashing
open_points.default_guess: Add boundary and forbidden-control cases to the named check.

open_points.subject: INV-022 through INV-025 witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-022, INV-023, INV-024, INV-025 [witness: verification:budget_management_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: What test proves producer non-activation, imported-plan immutability, activation failure atomicity, and source_key-only linking with display-name matching forbidden?
options: Extend the named check to every clause of all four invariants
Split the four invariants into separately bound focused checks
open_points.default_guess: Split them and add the missing producer, immutability, atomicity, and linking cases.

open_points.subject: INV-020 snapshot immutability witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-020 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: What check attempts and refuses mutation and deletion of an already accepted snapshot, rather than only duplicate insertion?
options: Add direct update and delete attempts to the named check
Narrow INV-020 to insertion uniqueness
open_points.default_guess: Add update and delete refusal cases with unchanged storage.

open_points.subject: INV-026 through INV-028 structural witness
open_points.text: INV-027: no table has a derived-value column, reading the views writes nothing, and after each change of an owning record (inclusion, allocations, progress, payment, plan) the next read equals a recomputation from the stored rows. INV-028: no service code deletes or replaces a portal section and no store surface removes one.
open_points.question: What verification can conclusively establish the absence of every derived-value column and every section-removal path, rather than relying on names, strings, or currently enumerated surfaces?
options: Define exhaustive schema and callable-surface checks whose completeness is itself fixed
Restate the invariants behaviorally so violating stored values or removals are observable
open_points.default_guess: Use explicit schema introspection plus a closed inventory of all service and store mutation surfaces.

open_points.subject: INV-028 activation refusal condition
open_points.text: activating a budget version without an allocated section is refused and writes nothing
open_points.question: Does “without an allocated section” mean a version omits a section currently targeted by an allocation, or that the version contains any section to which no expense is allocated?
options: Refuse only when an existing allocation targets a section absent from the candidate version
Refuse whenever any candidate-version section has no allocation
open_points.default_guess: Refuse only unresolved existing allocations whose target section has no plan in the candidate version.

witness.initial: A candidate budget version contains sections A and B; an included expense is allocated only to A, and no allocation targets a section absent from the candidate version.
events: An authorized staff member activates the candidate version.
outcomes: Activation succeeds because there are no unresolved allocations.
Activation is refused because section B is an unallocated section.
witness.observer: The activating staff member and readers of the active budget version.

open_points.subject: INV-032 and INV-036 intake witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-032, INV-036 [witness: verification:expense_intake_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: Must the intake check prove correction/allocation atomicity and the invariants at every later commit point, or only initial intake behavior?
options: Extend it to later correction and replacement flows
Bind it only to the initial-intake clauses and use other checks for later commits
open_points.default_guess: Limit this binding to intake and bind later commit behavior separately.

open_points.subject: INV-032 correction atomicity witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-032, INV-036 [witness: verification:expense_management_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: What check injects a failure between amount correction and allocation replacement and proves that neither half commits?
options: Add a failure-injection rollback scenario
Treat successful correction plus validation refusals as sufficient
open_points.default_guess: Add failure injection between the two writes and compare all affected rows.

open_points.subject: INV-035 confirmed-only totals witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-035 [witness: verification:derived_views_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: What check shows that an included but unconfirmed expense cannot participate in financial totals?
options: Seed or construct an unconfirmed expense and assert exclusion
Remove the confirmed-only clause if the model makes such state impossible
open_points.default_guess: Assert the condition at the lowest boundary where an unconfirmed stored/input state could otherwise enter totals.

open_points.subject: INV-052 append-only witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-052 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
open_points.question: What test attempts and refuses updates and deletions of both audit records and import records?
options: Add update and delete attempts for both record types
Narrow INV-052 to duplicate-insert behavior
open_points.default_guess: Add direct mutation and deletion refusal cases for both append-only record types.

open_points.subject: TXN-002 unchanged-exception witness
open_points.text: TXN-001, TXN-002: the transaction guard check [witness: verification:transaction_guard_client_portal].
open_points.question: How must the check establish that the original domain-error object reaches the caller unchanged, rather than merely an exception of the same type?
options: Assert object identity and unchanged contents
Define “unchanged” to mean only the same exception type
open_points.default_guess: Assert the same exception object by identity and verify its contents.

open_points.subject: TRN-001 and TRN-003 runtime witness
open_points.text: TRN-001, TRN-002, TRN-003: the runtime behaviour check [witness: verification:runtime_behavior_client_portal].
open_points.question: What must prove that rejected host/body requests never enter any handler and that every credential, cookie, and secret value is absent from actual emitted log lines?
options: Instrument handler entry and inject every secret class into real logging paths
Narrow the binding to rejection statuses and the one tested query secret
open_points.default_guess: Instrument handler entry and inspect actual logs with representative values of every secret class.

open_points.subject: TRN-003 transport-guard witness
open_points.text: TRN-001, TRN-003: the transport guard check [witness: verification:transport_guard_client_portal].
open_points.question: How must this check exercise actual credential and cookie values in emitted logs rather than scanning a synthetic non-secret record for selected words?
options: Inject secret values through real request/log paths and assert exact-value absence
Narrow the TRN-003 binding to the synthetic record behavior
open_points.default_guess: Test real emitted log lines with authorization, cookie, and secret values.

open_points.subject: TRN-002 API witness
open_points.text: TRN-002: the API transport check [witness: verification:api_transport_financial_policy_registry_gateway_client_portal].
open_points.question: What check proves that viewer sign-out from a foreign Origin is refused as well as that a cookie-less project read is refused?
options: Add foreign-origin sign-out to the named check
Split TRN-002 between two explicitly bound checks
open_points.default_guess: Add canonical, missing, and foreign Origin sign-out cases to the named check.

open_points.subject: clock formal invariant identifier
open_points.text: All portal-owned event timestamps written by one operation, other than an audit record's `occurred_at`, are equal; an expiry it derives from a TTL is that instant plus its TTL, and source-supplied times, a service credential's supplied `expires_at` among them, keep their supplied values.
open_points.question: What stable invariant ID owns this changed formal invariant and lets its Required tests and witness bindings name it unambiguously?
options: Assign a stable invariant ID to the whole clock invariant
Split timestamp equality, TTL derivation, and source-time preservation into separately identified invariants
open_points.default_guess: Split the independently testable clauses into stable identified invariants.

witness.initial: Later states receive the formal invariant and its two witness lines.
events: One agent maps the witness phrase “one instant per operation” to timestamp equality only.
Another agent treats the same unnumbered invariant as also binding TTL derivation and source-supplied-time preservation.
outcomes: Only timestamp equality becomes a required downstream check.
All three clauses become required downstream checks under one unnamed obligation.
witness.observer: The State 6–7 authors and the decision-witness resolver.

open_points.subject: source-supplied datetime persistence
open_points.text: Persisted timestamps are UTC, stored as offset-naive datetimes. Times a source supplies — `approved_at`, `published_at` of a snapshot, `confirmed_at` and `document_date` of a recognition, `photo_date`, `payment_date`, a service credential's `expires_at` — are kept as supplied, never replaced by the clock.
open_points.question: When a source supplies an offset-aware UTC datetime that becomes a persisted field, must the portal preserve the offset-aware representation or convert it to the required offset-naive UTC representation while preserving the instant?
options: Preserve the supplied representation exactly, including its UTC offset
Normalize to offset-naive UTC while preserving the supplied instant
open_points.default_guess: Normalize persisted values to offset-naive UTC while preserving the source-supplied instant.

witness.initial: A producer supplies `approved_at = 2026-11-08T10:00:00+00:00`; SnapshotPublication accepts a datetime and an accepted snapshot persists all publication fields.
events: The authenticated producer publishes the snapshot.
The portal accepts and persists ApprovedEstimateSnapshot.approved_at.
outcomes: “kept as supplied” preserves an offset-aware `+00:00` datetime.
“Persisted timestamps … offset-naive” stores `2026-11-08 10:00:00` without an offset.
witness.observer: The persistence adapter, later readers, and tests comparing the stored snapshot.

open_points.subject: configuration-invariant runtime witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: required configuration [witness: verification:runtime_settings_client_portal].
open_points.question: What test proves the existence and configuration-driven value of every timeout, TTL, rate limit, and bound, rather than only the viewer-entry settings?
options: Enumerate every required knob in a table-driven startup test
Narrow the invariant to the settings the check covers
open_points.default_guess: Use a closed table of every timeout, TTL, rate limit, and bound and test each entry.

open_points.subject: configuration-invariant binary witness
open_points.text: Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: bound existence [witness: verification:binary_storage_content_client_portal].
open_points.question: Is this check intended to witness only the binary-read bound or the formal invariant covering every timeout, TTL, rate limit, and bound?
options: Bind it only to a separately identified binary-read-bound invariant
Extend it to every configuration category
open_points.default_guess: Bind it only to an explicitly identified binary-read-bound obligation.

open_points.subject: DEP-002 public-advisory witness
open_points.text: DEP-002: the pre-deploy vulnerability check of those pins passes: the deploy step judges every distribution installed in the built image, bound to its content id, against a public advisory snapshot no older than the deploy route's maximum snapshot age, and starts the service only on a passing verdict about that same image no older than its maximum environment age; a listed version, stale, missing or unmatchable data, or another image does not start it [witness: verification:dependency_release_gate_client_portal].
open_points.question: What verification establishes that the advisory snapshot actually originates from a public known-vulnerability database rather than an arbitrary configured export?
options: Validate and bind trusted public-source identity and snapshot provenance
Remove the public-source claim and require only the supplied advisory data
open_points.default_guess: Require authenticated provenance from an explicitly allowed public advisory source.
